name: keycloak
description: Keycloak (Postgres): DB auto-detection dumps the Postgres DB (postgres:16-alpine). The bundled pgbackups sidecar (prodrigestivill/postgres-backup-local) is correctly NOT recognized as a database (backup marker in the image name). The themes/provider volumes (configuration) are included in the backup; the raw Postgres data dir is excluded/not tarred - the logical dump replaces it. Keycloak's realm data (users, clients, client secrets, keys) lives entirely in Postgres - the DB dump is sufficient for restore, no external key needed. Check that POSTGRES_DB matches the database used in KC_DB_URL ('keycloak').
